source='''def transform(grid):
    """Restore hidden cells from diagonal and repeated-row/column symmetry."""
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] != 6:
                continue
            seen = {(r, c)}
            pending = [(r, c)]
            value = 6
            while pending and value == 6:
                a, b = pending.pop()
                if grid[a][b] != 6:
                    value = grid[a][b]
                    break
                for x, y in ((b, a), (31 - a, b), (a, 31 - b)):
                    if 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n and (x, y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x, y))
                        pending.append((x, y))
            out[r][c] = value
    return out
